newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ajinomoto knocked lower by probe report.
newsitem.headline: Ajinomoto knocked lower by probe report.

text.p: Ajinomoto Co shares tumbled on Tuesday afternoon after media reports said the firm was being investigated for suspected links to "sokaiya" racketeers and that an arrest warrant had been issued for an official, traders said.
As of 0537 GMT, the shares were down 66 yen at 944, the third-largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
Ajinomoto was not immediately available for comment on the reports. Police declined to comment.

Kyodo news agency reported on Tuesday that police were investigating the manufacturer of foodstuffs and seasonings on suspicion that it provided money to sokaiya in violation of Japan's commercial law.
The agency later reported that Tokyo District Court had issued a warrant for police to arrest an Ajinomoto official on suspicion of providing money to racketeers.
